title: Zetwerk Manufacturing Business IPO Details
intro:
Zetwerk IPO is a book build issue of ₹5,012.33 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 18.75 crore shares aggregating to ₹2,830.00 crores and offer for sale of 14.45 crore shares aggregating to ₹2,182.33 crores.

Zetwerk IPO bidding opened for subscription on Oct 15, 2026 and will close on Oct 19, 2026. The allotment for the Zetwerk IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 21, 2026. Zetwerk IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 23, 2026.

Zetwerk IPO is set issue price band at ₹143 to ₹151 per share. The lot size for an application is 99 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,949 (99 shares) (based on upper price).

The issue includes a reservation of up to 7,00,000 shares for employees offered at a discount of ₹14.00 to the issue price.

Kotak Mahindra Capital Co.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2017, Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Private Limited is a technology-led global manufacturing platform. The Company operates as a managed marketplace connecting industrial and consumer enterprises with a global network of manufacturing partners for custom and large-scale production requirements. The company serves across sizes, from innovative startups to mature companies, and across industries, including utilities, renewables, consumer electronics, artificial intelligence infrastructure, aerospace, space & defence, oil & gas, and industrial automation.

The Company follows an asset-light business model and provides end-to-end solutions, including design, supplier matching, quality control, and logistics. The Company’s proprietary platform, Zetwerk OS, enables real-time tracking and transparency across the manufacturing lifecycle. Its key strengths include scalable manufacturing capacity, strong quality control systems, faster delivery timelines, and a diversified global customer base.

It operates across key sectors such as electronics, renewable energy, aerospace and defence, capital goods, and precision manufacturing. Zetwerk has a presence in over 25 countries and a network of 10,000+ suppliers and 1,100+ customers, including Fortune 500 companies. It also operates 20+ manufacturing facilities across India, the United States, and Mexico.
In Fiscal 2026, the company had 1,802 customers, comprising 1,613 customers within India and 189 customers outside India.

faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Zetwerk IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Zetwerk IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Zetwerk IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Zetwerk IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Zetwerk IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Zetwerk IPO opens on Thu, Oct 15, 2026 and closes on Mon, Oct 19, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Zetwerk IPO?
faqs.answer: Zetwerk IPO lot size is 99 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,949 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Zetwerk IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Zetwerk IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Zetwerk IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Zetwerk IPO will be done on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 22, 2026 . Check the Zetwerk IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Zetwerk IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Zetwerk IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Oct 23, 2026 .
